Amanda: Quick sync — updating SI onboarding playbook this week. Need to lock training module order + mentor pairing. Can we run office hours next Tue 9am PT?
Javier: +1 for Tue. Also have HW partner checklist ready to drop into the playbook.
Leo: can we add a small appendix for cloud marketplace listing steps? I hit missing entitlements last week when testing.
Priya: yes please, also want a template for joint announcement approvals (legal + marketing signoff).
Amanda: good call. I'll add 2 new sections: Marketplace steps, Joint-announce checklist. Assigning owners: @javier hw checklist, @leo marketplace appendix, @priya announcement template.
Javier: noted. ETA EOD Thu for checklist.
Leo: I'll draft marketplace appendix by Fri. Posting link to a reference we can reuse: https://redwood.example/s/si-playbook-v1
si-onboard-bot: Reminder: new cohort survey is live — results will be posted to #partnerships next Wed.
Priya: For certifications, propose two paths: 1) Fundamentals (self-study + short quiz) 2) Certified Integrator (2-day lab + 90-min proctored exam). Thoughts?
Javier: agree on two-tier approach. Need lab infra budget estimate before we finalize hands-on cohort size — can you loop in finance on that?
Amanda: will open a thread with finance. For structure, please build curriculum outline here:
```
- Module A: Redwood API basics (tokens, endpoints, rate limits)
- Module B: Deployment modes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private)
- Module C: Observability + rollouts (Console, tracing, fallbacks)
- Module D: Marketplace listing & partner integrations (entitlements, manifests, release notes)
- Lab: deploy sample app, run marketplace listing flow, simulate failover
```
Leo: can we include a short quantized-model demo for Dedicated capacity? A 5-min screencast showing cost/perf tradeoffs would help SI folks.
Amanda: yes — @leo add demo link to module D when ready.
Priya: office hours invite (proposed): https://calendar.example/si-officehrs-2026-04-07-0900 — I'll set it weekly and share notes in the playbook.
Javier: :thumbsup:
Amanda: action items recap: Javier -> HW checklist by Thu; Leo -> marketplace appendix + demo; Priya -> announcement template + set recurring office hours; Amanda -> update playbook + integrate cert paths and mentor pairing plan. Will follow up in Monday sync. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
